Fox Sports Data Functions

Read-only Fox Sports (Bifrost) WNBA + WBB wrappers (play-by-play, boxscore, odds, roster, stats, game log, standings, teams, leaders)

fox_wnba_boxscore() fox_wbb_boxscore()
Get Fox Sports basketball boxscore
fox_wnba_league_leaders() fox_wbb_league_leaders()
Get Fox Sports basketball statistical leaders
fox_wnba_odds() fox_wbb_odds()
Get Fox Sports basketball game odds
fox_wnba_pbp() fox_wbb_pbp()
Get Fox Sports basketball play-by-play
fox_wnba_standings() fox_wbb_standings()
Get Fox Sports basketball standings
fox_wnba_team_gamelog() fox_wbb_team_gamelog()
Get Fox Sports basketball team game log
fox_wnba_team_roster() fox_wbb_team_roster()
Get Fox Sports basketball team roster
fox_wnba_team_stats() fox_wbb_team_stats()
Get Fox Sports basketball team stat leaders
fox_wnba_teams() fox_wbb_teams()
Get Fox Sports basketball team directory
fox_wbb_teams_all()
Get the full Fox Sports women's college basketball team directory

WNBA Crosswalk Functions

Live builders and cached loaders that link ESPN, WNBA Stats API, and Fox team/game/player identities. Team and player crosswalks are keyed on espn_team_id; schedule crosswalk is keyed on espn_game_id.

wnba_team_crosswalk()
Get the WNBA cross-source team crosswalk
wnba_schedule_crosswalk()
Get the WNBA cross-source schedule crosswalk
wnba_player_crosswalk()
Get the WNBA cross-source player crosswalk
load_wnba_team_crosswalk()
Load cached WNBA team crosswalk
load_wnba_schedule_crosswalk()
Load cached WNBA schedule crosswalk
load_wnba_player_crosswalk()
Load cached WNBA player crosswalk

WBB Crosswalk Functions

Live builders and cached loaders that link ESPN, Fox Sports (Bifrost), and Bart Torvik (barttorvik.com/ncaaw) WBB team/game/player identities. Keyed on espn_team_id. Also includes women’s Torvik ratings/schedule scrapers and the Fox full-directory enumerator.

wbb_team_crosswalk()
Get the WBB cross-source team crosswalk
wbb_schedule_crosswalk()
Get the WBB cross-source schedule crosswalk
wbb_player_crosswalk()
Get the WBB cross-source player crosswalk
load_wbb_team_crosswalk()
Load cached WBB team crosswalk
load_wbb_schedule_crosswalk()
Load cached WBB schedule crosswalk
load_wbb_player_crosswalk()
Load cached WBB player crosswalk
bart_wbb_ratings()
Bart Torvik Women's T-Rank Ratings
bart_wbb_game_schedule()
Bart Torvik Women's Season Schedule & Results
fox_wbb_teams_all()
Get the full Fox Sports women's college basketball team directory
